round-0: The page as it was: two rows of pill toggles, pink on black, monospace labels, details panel below the fold on phones.
round-1: New layout: full-screen model, icon rail, view tabs, one reading column on desktop and a bottom sheet on phones. Serif title, single coral accent, dot labels. Camera pulled back; mons fat pad no longer pokes past the skin.
round-2: Owner's-manual direction: grey studio backdrop, Archivo type, numbered callouts matching a numbered parts list, safety-yellow highlight, labelled tool column (bottom tool bar on phones), one tour button, callouts capped at 14 (7 on phones). Cut organs drawn as solid; hip wings hidden in the cut; selecting an internal part makes the skin see-through; phone sheet opens to show the explanation.
round-3: Callouts redrawn as a parts diagram: a dot on the part, a leader line, a numbered label that searches six spots to avoid overlaps. Each view auto-fits its subject into the space the panels leave. One docked right column, crisp borders, yellow only for selection, a drawn 5 cm ruler, stable part numbers, 'Cut in half' removed (Side cut does it), phone toolbar cut to five items. Warm edge translucency on soft tissue.
round-4: Selecting an internal part flies the camera to it and fades everything else (a chip says what is isolated, with Show all). Fewer callouts on load (9 desktop, 5 phone) chosen per view: the openings outside, the organs in the cut. Figure captions (Fig. 1 · External view). X-ray is an on/off switch with a strength slider. Phase boundaries drawn on the arousal track. Bone struts gone from the Outside view. Uppercase eyebrows removed; right column hugs its content.
round-5: Rendering: faded parts become fresnel outlines (X-ray and isolation context stay legible), stronger key light, less flat environment light. Views aim at the centre of their subject. Callouts laid out as a parts diagram in two columns with non-crossing elbow leaders. Quieter isolation chip; ruler hides when foreshortened; no pink selection glow.
round-6: Illustration rendering: ink outlines on every solid part (yellow and heavier on the selected part), drawn a fixed pixel width like a technical drawing. The Outside view is now a close crop that fades into the backdrop instead of a floating skin patch. Caption and ruler kept apart.
round-7: Coherent line art: outlines in a darker shade of each part's own colour, none on the skin. Arousal and X-ray moved to their own panel; the reading column only reads. Guided tour demoted to a secondary button; compact phone header ('Tour'); caption says when X-ray is on; callouts never start under the title or tabs; phone sheet opens lower.
round-8: Selecting a part frames it at about half the free area (same fitting as the views). Isolation context drawn as neutral grey outlines; selected part outlined in heavy ink. Each view has its own introduction in the reading column. Tools and simulation controls share one left column.
round-9: Real reference anatomy: the hand-built bones replaced by the NIH Human Reference Atlas female pelvis (Visible Human Female, CC BY 4.0), aligned on the symphysis and promontory. Checked against the NIH uterus and ovaries: ovaries moved out to the pelvic side wall (5.3 cm from the midline), tubes re-routed, rectum refitted to the real sacral hollow and flattened as an empty rectum is. Fixed a bug that moved the ovary anchor on every measurement.
round-10: Context and navigation: the page opens on a see-through body (first the NIH Visible Human Female, then a slim MakeHuman woman with a mannequin head) with a Body outline slider, uterine ligaments from the NIH set, and Previous/Next part stepping with arrow keys.
round-11: Body view frames the hips with the body as context; fewer callouts at overview scale; the caption names the selected part; choosing a part from the overview opens it in its own view; the body outline hides while a part is isolated; Run an orgasm demoted to a secondary button; shorter phone view tabs and Tour button; a drag that returns to its start no longer counts as a tap.
round-12: Body view framed on the trunk and hips only (arms left out), so the pelvis is the hero; Arousal, X-ray and Body outline moved into a panel opened from the tool rail instead of a permanent corner card.
round-13: Rail settings shown as switches (only open panels fill black); the current view tab stays marked during isolation; on phones Show all moved from a banner into the details sheet; lighter selection outline.
round-14: Phone details sheet header on two rows (category and close, then stepper and Show all) so nothing wraps; Step through the parts promoted to the primary button; more space under the desktop title.
